title: Carmina
thumbnail_desc: Inspired by the timeless allure of Denmark's coasts, Shore Collection celebrates the serene yet dynamic essence of the shoreline and bustling harbors that define the Danish landscape.
description: Located on Carrer de l’Argenteria, in the historic heart of Barcelona, the restaurant inhabits a street where elegance and memory coexist, shaped by the textures of the old neighbourhood. Part of an Italian chain, its identity is revealed upon entry through a generous patio that merges Spanish and Italian traditions of shaping interior space. The project’s main objective was to increase seating capacity on the upper floor without sacrificing Italian charm. This was achieved by drawing the seating to the perimeter, with custom-designed sofas whose chromatic bases and mirrored back panels amplify light and spatial depth. A black-painted ceiling and wall lamps resting above the mirrors create an intimate, almost theatrical atmosphere, ready to host dark green and red Italian fabrics that infuse the space with a refined and unmistakably Italian soul.
